title: Puts out little vapor and doesn't run for long
text: Puts out little vapor and doesn't run for long. The reservoir is small. The whole thing is very small. Which isn't too much of a problem other than it doesn't run for very long.  It adds a little moisture to the air, but you really need to be close to it.  I wouldn't buy this again.

Plus, it’s whisper quiet so it won’t disturb your busy lifestyle, your sleep or your work. The filter free feature means that you don’t have to stop in the middle of your day and replace costly filters or wicks.

Its chic, compact and portable design allows it to fit virtually anywhere and only takes up as much space as a computer mouse. You may not even notice it’s there! Great for travel or use in the office or car. It has the capacity to run nonstop for 1.5 hours.
